name: paul-trap-ejected
description: Published: the tabulated Mathieu ejection boundary for a 3-D quadrupole trap on the a = 0 line is q_z = 0.90804, and this model sits at q_z = 1.20. Ejected. q_z = 1.20, above every boundary in play, so the ion leaves - and it leaves axially, on an endcap at exactly z0, because q_r is half q_z and the axial direction goes unstable first. Run this beside its held twin: together they bracket the published cut-off, which is a stronger statement than either alone.
